**Job Title : Assembly Manufacturing Engineer/ Manufacturing Engineer I**
**Location : Moline, IL**
**Contract Duration : 12+ Months Contract with possibility to extend or conversion to Full time**
**Shift Timings : 1st Shift (6:00-2:30pm)**
**Pay Rate - $35 - $40/hr. on w2     **
Top 3 skillsets:
1.) Experience with process improvement projects (Example: directly targeting production metrics like cycle time reduction, scrap elimination, ergonomic safety, and tool design)
2.) Support in a production/factory floor UAW environment
3.) Knowledge of basic assembly tooling and equipment (Fixtures, Torque, MES system)
Your Responsibilities:
As an OFP Assembly Manufacturing Engineer for Seeding Group located in Moline, IL, you will:
* Support daily operations by responding to tactical safety, quality, and efficiency issues while supporting/leading performance improvements for the business unit team
* Support uptime of tools, fixtures, and equipment
* Support/lead engineering projects to improve safety, quality, and efficiency through torque tooling improvements, capital investment projects, JDAAT expansion/deployment
* Identify opportunities & implement continuous improvement projects in support of achieving CI200 target goals for safety, quality, delivery, and efficiency

...

* 1-3 years' experience supporting production/factory floor in a UAW environment
* Working knowledge of basic assembly tooling and equipment
* Ability to work flexible hours, including overtime (daily and weekends as needed)
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to communicate cross-functionally with both salary and wage workforce
* Demonstrated ability to initiate and complete multiple, concurrent projects

...

Ideally, will have a degree or equivalent related work experience in the following:
Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent/related field

THIS ROLE WILL SUPPORT OUR CORPORATE ORLANDO MARKET
PAY RANGE: $80,000 - $95,000 + a 30% bonus potential
As we continue to grow, our strategies have set us up for success to be the top offering in Chicken Fingerz, Boneless Wings, and Zalads. We’d love to have you as part of our team!
**Benefits Include
**
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Company-Paid Disability, Critical Illness, and Basic Life Insurance
* 401K with Company Match
* 50% Off Meal Discount at Company-Owned Locations
* Parental Leave
* Child Care Assistance
* Education Assistance Program
* PTO and 9 Company Holidays + 2 Floating Holidays
**PAYDEFINITION
** The District Manager is accountable for profitability, development of leaders, and operational performance while ensuring Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and system compliance in each location within their market. Each market consists of 5 to 8 locations.
The District Manager works closely with marketing and recruiting to drive guest traffic and build internal talent pipelines of team members who are lead and developed into future leaders.
**Essential Job Functions
** Essential duties may include but are not limited to the following:
* Sets quarterly goals for each management team that are in line with the Zax LLC strategic plan and meet the required expectation for each metric
* Acts as a funnel when information is needed to be passed down from Zax LLC headquarters and Zaxbys Franchising LLC to the field
* Develops store level managers through influence and governance
* Recruits future talent that fits the Zaxbys Culture
* Focuses on building people so that they can in turn build the business
* Explains the “Why” when coaching future leaders while also utilizing the Plan, Tell, Show, Do, Review (PTSDR) training method
* Works a minimum of 6 hours in each location, within their district, bi-weekly
* Plans and prepares for each store visit with the intention of development and commits to limiting outside distraction via cell phone or email during store visits
* Conducts store inspections to ensure that brand standards and procedures are being upheld at all times
* Ensures protection of the Brand through adherence to standards and policies
* Uses creative and innovative strategies to create and maintain community partnerships with a variety of organizations
* Collaborates with Zax LLC headquarters when needed to solve roadblocks within their district
* All other duties necessary to ensure district operations function properly
* Work with varying departments to select, evaluate, and approve opportunities for growth in the District
**KEY COMPETENCIES
**
